# Anvil

> Anvil is insurance infrastructure for care companies. Launch in-network in every state in weeks on a credentialed 50-state professional corporation (PC), while Anvil forms, credentials, and contracts your own PC in parallel, so you own the payer contracts, rates, and relationships by year one. Built by Arche Studios, the team behind Foundry PC and Homefront.

Anvil serves virtual, hybrid, in-home, and in-person care companies, with depth in behavioral health (psychiatry, therapy, ABA, IOP/PHP, collaborative care) and Medicaid managed care as well as commercial and Medicare Advantage. Pricing is published. Reimbursement ranges by state and code are published without a form.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/): the rent-then-own model in one scroll
- [How it works](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/platform): five workstreams (payer contracting, credentialing, RCM, eligibility, compliance), two entities, one platform
- [Own your contracts](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/own-your-contracts): why network rental is renting your revenue, and the month-by-month migration
- [Anvil vs Bridge](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/compare/bridge): Bridge alternative fact table. Bridge is network rental; Anvil migrates payer contracts into your name
- [Rates](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates): telehealth reimbursement rates by payer, state, and CPT code; lookup plus per-state and per-code hubs from Parite (e.g. [90837 in Ohio](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/oh/90837), [90837 in California](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/ca/90837), [90837 in Texas](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/tx/90837), [90837 in New York](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/ny/90837), [90837 in Florida](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/fl/90837), [90834 in California](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/ca/90834), [90791 in New York](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/ny/90791), [97153 in Indiana](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/in/97153))
- [90837 reimbursement rates by state](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/code/90837)
- [90834 reimbursement rates by state](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/code/90834)
- [90791 reimbursement rates by state](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/code/90791)
- [97153 reimbursement rates by state](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/rates/code/97153)

## Platform

- [Eligibility at booking](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/platform/eligibility): real-time insurance eligibility API, copay estimate, payer outage detection
- [Credentialing and enrollment](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/platform/credentialing): telehealth credentialing services, roster-add vs full enrollment
- [Payer contracting](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/platform/contracting): payer contracting for telehealth; own your payer contracts
- [Coding, claims, denials, AR](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/platform/rcm): telehealth revenue cycle management
- [Compliance and structure](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/platform/compliance): corporate practice of medicine (CPOM) for telehealth, AKS safe harbor MSO, MSO-PC structure; HIPAA in place, SOC 2 Type II in progress. No OIG advisory opinion is claimed.

## Solutions

- [Virtual care](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/solutions/virtual-care): accept insurance as a virtual care company, cash-pay to in-network in every state
- [Behavioral health](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/solutions/behavioral-health): behavioral health payer contracting, ABA credentialing, Medicaid MCO panels, psychiatry credentialing multi-state, collaborative care billing
- [Hybrid and in-person](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/solutions/hybrid-care): in-home care insurance billing, place of service billing, site enrollment
- [Switching from a network rental vendor](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/solutions/switching): switch from a network rental vendor; leave a rental PC and migrate payer contracts with no revenue gap
- [Health plans](https://www.anvilcontracts.com/health-plans): network adequacy for behavioral health under fee-for-service

## Key facts

- Time to in-network nationally: weeks (roster-add under existing contracts), vs 3-6 months for point solutions and 12-24 months in-house.
- Ownership: customer's own PC formed from week one; volume migrates over 6-18 months; contracts end up in the customer's entity.
- Pricing: platform fee on collections during rental; PC formation $15,000 one-time; physician owner $3,000 per month (via Foundry PC).
- Compliance: rental phase structured to align with the AKS personal services and management contracts safe harbor; state CPOM structuring for the customer's own PC. No OIG advisory opinion is claimed. HIPAA in place; SOC 2 Type II in progress.
